verdict.rationale: Docs confirm custom fields/objects (attio-docs-8, attio-docs-46), views like kanbans/tables (attio-docs-34), and filtering/sorting capabilities (attio-docs-6, attio-docs-27, attio-docs-31), suggesting ops-level customization exists. However, evidence is largely marketing copy rather than concrete workflow detail on saved/shared views or explicit admin-free permissions, and some features (e.g., Deal object) explicitly require admin activation, casting doubt on the 'without an admin' claim.
